method: Hand verdicts on every v2 defect flag on the outside pages (outside.mjs), per page and check, from a crop of the flagged element at the flagged width and the page's CSS. TP: the condition exists as the check defines it and a designer would change it. FP: the check misread the page (wrong element, hidden text, wrong pairing, the break caused by a control). boundary: the condition exists but sits at the check's threshold, so a designer might reasonably leave it. unverified: the crop did not show the element. Made by the builder of the probe, after reading each flag's detail, so not blind.
